summary.name: Fathom
summary.one_liner: Fathom is an AI notetaker that records, transcribes, and summarizes Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams calls, with optional bot-free capture and sync to team tools.
use_cases: sales call review and CRM updates
summary.what_it_does:
Fathom captures meetings on Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams, either with a bot or bot-free, and transcribes them. It produces AI summaries available shortly after a call, along with action items delivered by email. An "Ask Fathom" feature lets users search across meetings and get customizable summaries. For teams, notes and insights sync to tools such as Slack, Salesforce, HubSpot, Notion, and Asana. The page also says meeting data can be used inside ChatGPT and Claude, and that key topics can be monitored automatically.</what_it_does>
